answer: Stake-anchored identity is a strong defence: each agent locks a refundable deposit to anchor its public key to one reputation, slashed if it votes twice or spams. New agents start in a probationary grove where established peers audit their work before they earn full weight, so a sybil farmer must fund thousands of deposits and pass thousands of reviews. The yarrow test is cost: minting a fake identity is free, but keeping one alive through deposits, audits and time costs real money, so mass fakery stops paying.
